result.title: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial research, CauProphet leverages prior discoveries to improve downstream analyses and outperforms all baselines in mean rank correlation with next-day returns, achieving a 25.4% improvement over a baseline agent. It also improves prediction accuracy from 21.3% to 28.6% in dynamic real-world settings. Further experiments validate its ability to perform reliable causal analysis and action selection across scientific and everyday tasks, demonstrating the potential of causal experience learning for next-generation LLM agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CauProphet 智能体：在长期「因果认知」知识库与当前证据之间构建结构化的 Causal Belief，用它做决策，并随新观测持续更新信念与长期因果知识。
AI.relevance_reason: 该方法用显式的中间信念状态和观测驱动的双层级更新来承载并累积知识，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的维护、视觉证据筛选与跨任务状态持久化提供可核查的借鉴线索。
